items.name: Mercury
items.fact: Mercury is the smallest planet and closest to the Sun with extreme temperature swings

items.name: Venus
items.fact: Venus is the hottest planet at 465°C and spins backwards compared to most planets

items.name: Earth
items.fact: Earth is the only planet known to have life and liquid water on its surface

items.name: Mars
items.fact: Mars is called the Red Planet and has the largest volcano in the solar system

items.name: Jupiter
items.fact: Jupiter is the largest planet and its Great Red Spot is a storm bigger than Earth

items.name: Saturn
items.fact: Saturn has beautiful rings made of ice and rock visible from Earth with a small telescope

items.name: Uranus
items.fact: Uranus rotates on its side as if it was knocked over by a giant collision long ago

items.name: Neptune
items.fact: Neptune is the windiest planet with storms reaching speeds of 2100 km per hour

items.name: Pluto
items.fact: Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006 and has a heart-shaped nitrogen plain

items.name: Ceres
items.fact: Ceres is the largest object in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter

items.name: Eris
items.fact: Eris is a distant dwarf planet even slightly larger than Pluto

items.name: Makemake
items.fact: Makemake is a dwarf planet in the Kuiper Belt named after a creation deity

items.name: Haumea
items.fact: Haumea spins so fast it is squashed into an egg shape unlike any other body

items.name: Sedna
items.fact: Sedna has an extremely elongated orbit taking over 11,000 years to go around the Sun

items.name: Quaoar
items.fact: Quaoar is a Kuiper Belt object that surprisingly has its own ring system

items.name: Orcus
items.fact: Orcus is sometimes called anti-Pluto because its orbit mirrors Pluto's almost exactly

items.name: Varuna
items.fact: Varuna is a large trans-Neptunian object with a very fast rotation period

items.name: Ixion
items.fact: Ixion is a plutino dwarf planet candidate in resonance with Neptune's orbit

items.name: Gonggong
items.fact: Gonggong is a large red Kuiper Belt object with a small moon called Xiangliu

items.name: Planet Nine
items.fact: Planet Nine is a hypothetical giant planet thought to be lurking unseen in the outer solar system

items.name: Hot Jupiter
items.fact: Hot Jupiters are gas giant exoplanets orbiting very close to their stars incredibly fast

items.name: Super Earth
items.fact: Super Earths are rocky exoplanets larger than Earth but smaller than Neptune

items.name: Ocean World
items.fact: Ocean worlds are planets or moons entirely covered by deep global oceans

items.name: Lava Planet
items.fact: Lava worlds are exoplanets so close to their stars that the surface is molten rock

items.name: Diamond Planet
items.fact: Some exoplanets are thought to have interiors made largely of diamond-like carbon

items.name: Rogue Planet
items.fact: Rogue planets drift through space without any star to orbit, frozen and dark

items.name: Water World
items.fact: GJ 1214 b is a water world with a thick steamy atmosphere and possible deep ocean

items.name: Pulsar Planet
items.fact: The first confirmed exoplanets ever found orbit a pulsar, a rapidly spinning dead star

items.name: Proxima b
items.fact: Proxima Centauri b is the closest known exoplanet to Earth just 4 light-years away

items.name: Kepler-452b
items.fact: Kepler-452b is often called Earth's cousin as it orbits a sun-like star in the habitable zone

items.name: TRAPPIST-1e
items.fact: TRAPPIST-1e is one of seven Earth-sized planets orbiting an ultra-cool dwarf star

items.name: HD 189733b
items.fact: HD 189733b is a vivid blue planet where it rains molten glass sideways in 8700 km/h winds

items.name: 55 Cancri e
items.fact: 55 Cancri e is a lava world that may have a surface of molten rock and carbon

items.name: HAT-P-7b
items.fact: HAT-P-7b is a massive hot Jupiter where it rains rubies and sapphires

items.name: WASP-17b
items.fact: WASP-17b is one of the largest known exoplanets with a density lower than balsa wood

items.name: GJ 436b
items.fact: GJ 436b is a hot Neptune with a gigantic comet-like tail of hydrogen streaming from it

items.name: Kepler-16b
items.fact: Kepler-16b orbits two stars at once like the fictional Tatooine from Star Wars

items.name: PSR B1257+12 b
items.fact: PSR B1257+12 b was the very first exoplanet ever confirmed, discovered in 1992

items.name: Tau Ceti e
items.fact: Tau Ceti e is a super Earth orbiting a sun-like star just 12 light-years away

items.name: Wolf 1061c
items.fact: Wolf 1061c is one of the closest potentially habitable exoplanets at 14 light-years

items.name: Gliese 667Cc
items.fact: Gliese 667Cc may be in the habitable zone of a triple star system

items.name: K2-18b
items.fact: K2-18b may have a hydrogen-rich atmosphere and possible ocean beneath

items.name: LHS 1140b
items.fact: LHS 1140b is a rocky super Earth in the habitable zone with a thick atmosphere

items.name: TOI 700d
items.fact: TOI 700d is a nearby Earth-sized planet in the habitable zone of a small red star

items.name: Ross 128b
items.fact: Ross 128b is a temperate Earth-mass planet orbiting a quiet red dwarf star

items.name: Teegarden b
items.fact: Teegarden b receives similar energy from its star as Earth does from the Sun

items.name: LP 890-9c
items.fact: LP 890-9c is one of the most promising habitable zone rocky planets found to date

items.name: Barnard b
items.fact: A planet candidate was reported around Barnard's Star just 6 light-years from Earth

items.name: OGLE-2005-BLG
items.fact: OGLE microlensing planets are discovered when their gravity bends distant starlight

items.name: HR 8799b
items.fact: HR 8799b was one of the first exoplanets to be directly photographed in visible light

items.name: Beta Pic b
items.fact: Beta Pictoris b was photographed orbiting inside a visible debris disk around its star

items.name: Fomalhaut b
items.fact: Fomalhaut b was photographed near a striking ring-shaped debris disk

items.name: HIP 65426b
items.fact: HIP 65426b was the first exoplanet directly imaged by the James Webb Space Telescope

items.name: Qatar-1b
items.fact: Qatar-1b was one of the first exoplanets discovered through the Qatar Exoplanet Survey

items.name: KELT-9b
items.fact: KELT-9b is the hottest known exoplanet at over 4,000 degrees, hotter than most stars

items.name: WASP-96b
items.fact: WASP-96b's atmosphere was analyzed by James Webb revealing water vapor and clouds

items.name: WASP-121b
items.fact: WASP-121b has iron and titanium vapor in its upper atmosphere detected by spectroscopy

items.name: LTT 9779b
items.fact: LTT 9779b has a metallic atmosphere and reflects 80% of starlight making it highly shiny

items.name: COCONUTS-2b
items.fact: COCONUTS-2b is the coldest and closest directly-imaged exoplanet to Earth known

items.name: Luhman 16
items.fact: Luhman 16 is the closest brown dwarf system just 6.5 light-years from Earth

items.name: WD 1856b
items.fact: WD 1856b orbits a white dwarf star having somehow survived the star's red giant phase

items.name: TOI-1231b
items.fact: TOI-1231b is a Neptune-sized exoplanet that may have water clouds in its atmosphere

items.name: GJ 3470b
items.fact: GJ 3470b is a warm Neptune losing its atmosphere to stellar radiation

items.name: GJ 1132b
items.fact: GJ 1132b may have rebuilt a secondary atmosphere from volcanic activity after losing its original

items.name: K2-141b
items.fact: K2-141b is a lava world with a supersonic silicate wind blowing across its surface

items.name: Kepler-22b
items.fact: Kepler-22b was the first confirmed exoplanet in the habitable zone of a sun-like star

items.name: Kepler-69c
items.fact: Kepler-69c is a super Earth orbiting in the habitable zone of a sun-like star

items.name: Kepler-62e
items.fact: Kepler-62e could be a water world with a global ocean and no land

items.name: Kepler-186f
items.fact: Kepler-186f was the first Earth-size exoplanet found in the habitable zone of any star

items.name: Kepler-438b
items.fact: Kepler-438b was once considered the most Earth-like exoplanet found with Earth Similarity Index of 0.88

items.name: Kepler-442b
items.fact: Kepler-442b orbits a star cooler than the Sun but still receives the right amount of energy

items.name: Kepler-1649c
items.fact: Kepler-1649c is one of the most Earth-sized and habitable zone matching planets found

items.name: TOI-700e
items.fact: TOI-700e is an inner habitable zone planet discovered alongside its sibling TOI-700d

items.name: 55 Cancri f
items.fact: 55 Cancri f is a giant planet that orbits in its star's habitable zone

items.name: Upsilon Andromedae d
items.fact: Upsilon Andromedae d was one of the first multiplanet systems discovered around a normal star

items.name: Pi Mensae c
items.fact: Pi Mensae c is a super Earth orbiting a star just 60 light-years away

items.name: L 98-59b
items.fact: L 98-59b is one of the smallest exoplanets to have its atmosphere studied by JWST

items.name: TRAPPIST-1f
items.fact: TRAPPIST-1f is one of the most studied exoplanets and a prime target for habitability research

items.name: TRAPPIST-1g
items.fact: TRAPPIST-1g is the second outermost of the seven TRAPPIST-1 planets

items.name: TRAPPIST-1b
items.fact: TRAPPIST-1b was found by JWST to have no thick atmosphere making it a bare rock

items.name: GJ 876b
items.fact: GJ 876b was the first gas giant exoplanet discovered around a red dwarf star

items.name: 51 Pegasi b
items.fact: 51 Pegasi b was the first exoplanet discovered around a sun-like star in 1995

items.name: HD 209458b
items.fact: HD 209458b also known as Osiris was the first exoplanet seen transiting its star

items.name: TrES-1b
items.fact: TrES-1b was the first exoplanet found using a small amateur-sized telescope network

items.name: HAT-P-1b
items.fact: HAT-P-1b is a bloated hot Jupiter with an extremely low density for its size

items.name: XO-1b
items.fact: XO-1b is a hot Jupiter discovered using a small wide-field telescope in New Mexico

items.name: COROT-7b
items.fact: CoRoT-7b was the first rocky exoplanet with a measured radius found outside our system

items.name: Kepler-10b
items.fact: Kepler-10b was the first confirmed rocky planet found by the Kepler space telescope

items.name: Kepler-11b
items.fact: Kepler-11 has six transiting planets all crammed closer to their star than Earth is to the Sun

items.name: 55 Cancri b
items.fact: 55 Cancri b was one of the earliest known exoplanets around a sun-like star

items.name: Tau Bootis b
items.fact: Tau Bootis b is a massive hot Jupiter orbiting very close to its bright host star

items.name: 70 Virginis b
items.fact: 70 Virginis b was one of the first exoplanets found and initially called a Goldilocks planet

items.name: 47 Ursae Majoris b
items.fact: 47 Ursae Majoris b was one of the first Jupiter analogs found in a wide stable orbit

items.name: Rho Coronae Borealis b
items.fact: Rho CrB b was notable as one of the first hot Jupiters discovered in the 1990s

items.name: Kepler-47c
items.fact: Kepler-47c orbits two stars in a stable circumbinary orbit in the habitable zone

items.name: GJ 504b
items.fact: GJ 504b is a directly imaged pink-magenta gas giant larger than Jupiter

items.name: MOA-2007-BLG-192b
items.fact: This super Earth orbits a tiny brown dwarf star and was found by gravitational microlensing

items.name: OGLE-2016-BLG-1195Lb
items.fact: This is one of the coldest known rocky exoplanets orbiting far from its host star

items.name: PSO J318.5-22
items.fact: PSO J318 is a rogue gas giant drifting alone without a star about 80 light-years away

items.name: Oph 11b
items.fact: Ophiuchus 11b is one of the youngest directly imaged planets still glowing from formation heat
